home.title: Tiny steps
home.tagline: Little games for little hands: colours, numbers, shapes and letters.
home.noFavourites: No favourites yet. Press the star on a game to add it here.
home.playsAnyway: The games still play, but changes are not kept.

settings.title: For grown-ups
settings.intro: Choose how the games sound and how hard they are.
settings.voiceNote: The games read words aloud with the device's own voice.
settings.challenge.gentle.about: A wrong answer costs nothing, so nobody loses.
settings.challenge.normal.about: A wrong answer takes 5 from the star meter. At 0 the game ends.
settings.challenge.strict.about: A wrong answer takes 10 from the star meter. At 0 the game ends.
settings.visitOnly: Changes here last only for this visit.
settings.about: Game ideas from Mika's Adorable Playhouse by KungPowUnicorn (MIT licence), rebuilt for Tellop.
games.animal-count.name: Animal count
games.animal-count.blurb: Count the animals as they walk in.
games.animal-count.howTo: Watch the animals come in. Tap each one to count, then pick the number.
games.colour-muncher.name: Colour basket
games.colour-muncher.blurb: Help the teddy fill its basket, one colour at a time.
games.colour-muncher.howTo: The teddy asks for one colour. Tap something that is that colour.
games.dot-to-dot.name: Dot to dot
games.dot-to-dot.blurb: Join the dots in order to make a picture.
games.dot-to-dot.howTo: Tap the dots in order: 1, 2, 3… and see what appears.
games.dot-to-dot.levels.easy: Pictures of 5 to 8 dots, the next dot glows
games.hungry-hedgehog.name: Hungry hedgehog
games.hungry-hedgehog.blurb: Feed the hedgehog the number it wants.
games.hungry-hedgehog.howTo: The hedgehog shows a number. Drag that number into its mouth.
games.hungry-hedgehog.levels.easy: 1 to 5, four numbers to pick from
games.hungry-hedgehog.levels.normal: 1 to 10, six numbers to pick from
games.hungry-hedgehog.levels.hard: 1 to 20, eight numbers to pick from
games.letter-flowers.name: Letter flowers
games.letter-flowers.blurb: Find letters and grow a flower.
games.letter-flowers.howTo: Tap the letter you hear to make the flower grow.
games.letter-flowers.levels.normal: Capital letters and a word, 6 to pick from
games.letter-muncher.name: Letter muncher
games.letter-muncher.blurb: Feed the monster the letter it asks for.
games.letter-muncher.howTo: Drag the letter the monster asks for into its mouth.
games.letter-tracing.name: Letter tracing
games.letter-tracing.blurb: Draw letters by tracing over them.
games.letter-tracing.howTo: Trace the letter with your finger or the mouse.
games.letter-tracing.levels.easy: Capital letters, a wide path and a guide line
games.little-builder.name: Little builder
games.little-builder.blurb: Build a house, a car and more from shapes.
games.little-builder.howTo: Listen for the colour and the shape, then tap the right piece to build.
games.little-builder.levels.easy: 3 pieces to pick from, the empty place blinks
games.little-builder.levels.normal: 4 pieces to pick from, some look alike
games.number-hunt.name: Number hunt
games.number-hunt.blurb: Find the number hiding on the board.
games.number-hunt.howTo: Listen for a number, then find it and tap it.
games.number-pond.name: Number pond
games.number-pond.blurb: Catch the fish with the right number.
games.number-pond.howTo: Fish swim by with numbers. Catch the fish that carries the number you hear.
games.number-tracing.name: Number tracing
games.number-tracing.blurb: Draw numbers by tracing over them.
games.number-tracing.howTo: Trace the number with your finger or the mouse.
games.number-tracing.levels.easy: 0 to 5, a wide path and a guide line
games.rainbow-maker.name: Rainbow maker
games.rainbow-maker.blurb: Sort things by colour and paint a rainbow.
games.rainbow-maker.howTo: Look at the thing on the belt. Tap the paint pot of the same colour.
games.shape-belt.name: Shape belt
games.shape-belt.blurb: Feed shapes to the monsters on the belt.
games.shape-belt.howTo: Drag each shape to the monster with the same mouth. Or tap a shape, then its monster.
games.shape-box.name: Shape box
games.shape-box.blurb: Put every shape in its own hole.
games.shape-box.howTo: Drag each shape into the hole that fits it. Or tap a shape, then its hole.
games.shape-box.prompt: Put each shape in its hole!
games.toy-room.name: Toy room
games.toy-room.blurb: Find the ball, the cube and the cone.
games.toy-room.howTo: Toys stand on a round rug. Tap the one you hear. Drag the rug to turn it and see each toy from every side.
games.toy-room.no3d: This game needs 3D drawing, and this computer cannot do it right now.
